before_start: Read this file (tasks.json) and run `git log --oneline -20` to understand recent history
Choose ONE task with status 'pending' and the highest priority (critical > high > medium > low); skip tasks with status 'deferred' (post-MVP / future versions)
Within the same priority, prefer the lowest TASK-ID (earlier in the critical path)
Check that ALL dependencies of the chosen task have status 'done'; if not, pick another task
Read prd/PRD.md sections referenced by the task description before coding
during_work: Work only on the selected task; do not touch unrelated code
Make small commits after each logical change with descriptive messages
Add a `TO-DO` comment with a clear question wherever the task needs a human decision (credentials, external accounts, business rules)
If a task requires a manual user action (for example, making Docker available), stop, leave it pending, and add a short blocker note to that task before asking the user
Never commit secrets, placeholder tokens, or `paste_your_token_here` literals
Use English for all code comments, docs, commit messages, and UI strings (UI uses 'Team', code/DB uses 'Tenant')
before_finish: Run ALL test_steps from the task end-to-end, not just unit tests
Run linters, formatters, and the project's full test suite
Change status to 'done' ONLY after every acceptance_criterion is met and every test_step passes
Append a dated summary entry to progress.md describing what was built, files touched, and any open TO-DOs
It is FORBIDDEN to delete, rename, or rewrite tasks — only update `status` and documented scope fields (`deferred_reason`, `target_release`)
If the task turns out to be too large for one session, leave it 'pending' and add a follow-up note in progress.md instead of partially completing it

tasks.description: Enable PostgreSQL Row-Level Security on every business table that has `tenant_id`, per PRD §7.2; set `app.current_tenant_id` as a session GUC from a Spring servlet filter that reads the JWT

tasks.description: Implement the Stripe webhook handler at `POST /api/v1/billing/webhook` with signature verification and handlers for `customer.subscription.updated`, `customer.subscription.deleted`, and `invoice.payment_failed`
acceptance_criteria: Signature verified with `STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET`; invalid signature → 400

Step 2: Fire `invoice.payment_failed` — `delayed_jobs` row scheduled for now+7d
Step 3: Tamper signature — 400; nothing changes in DB

Invite create: COUNT(active users) < plan_seat_limit; else 402 `SEAT_LIMIT_EXCEEDED`

Step 2: Starter tenant on 5 seats — 6th invite → 402
Step 3: Free tenant attempts schema edit — 402 `PLAN_FEATURE_LOCKED`

Step 3: Period rolls over via webhook — counters reset, thresholds re-armed
